protocol.order: backend -> model -> Clamp then SlidingWindow -> pinned candidate order
protocol.metrics: Unicode-scalar CER and whitespace-token WER; raw ordinal and explicit invariant-lowercase views; no punctuation/space removal
protocol.qualityStrata: Main quality: legible=true and source bbox height>=2px (11); official illegible (1) and 1px-height geometry (1) retained separately.
protocol.measurements: One untimed execution per line/mode/backend; no speed or statistical significance claim

crossBackend.boundary: Text, emitted classes and window decisions only; native output tensors and confidence values are not claimed bitwise equal.

localTraceEvidence.scope: Local diagnostic artifact with annotation text and raw window tokens; excluded from repository summaries.

detailedEvidence.location: Ignored artifacts/paddleocr-natural-wide-gt-20261023-final; source images, labels and raw text/token traces are not distributed in this summary.

result: Execution/source/window contracts pass. Paired quality deltas are recorded per backend/model; positive edit deltas mean worse SlidingWindow quality. No default-policy or seam-threshold change.
boundary: A2 is a >3200 normalized-pixel-width gate, not a 3200-character gate. This bounded geometry-selected slice is recognizer-only, not detector/page accuracy, official HierText scoring, seam ground truth or release acceptance. Repeated-number/single-character seam sets, further backends and wider independent validation remain open.
